 Hon'ble Shri Justice Sachin Singh Rajput
 Order on Board
19/01/2023
 1.

This is the First Bail Application filed under Section 439 of Code of  Criminal Procedure for grant of bail in connection with Crime  No.423/2022 registered at Police Station Balod, District Balod (C.G.) for  the offence under Sections 363, 376(2)(>)(<)of IPC and Section 4 of  POCSO Act.

2. Brief facts of the case is that the applicant has abducted the minor girl  from the lawful guardianship without their consent and committed sexual  intercourse with her.
 3. Learned counsel for the applicant submits that the allegation against the  present applicant is false and fictitious, he is in jail since 22/09/2022,
 prosecutrix has not supported the case of the prosecution, charge-sheet  has been filed, hence he may be entitled for grant of bail.
 4.
On the other hand, learned counsel for the respondent/State opposes the bail application.

5. Prosecutrix and her father appeared through video conferencing from the concerned DLSA and made 'No Objection' with regard to grant of bail to the applicant.
6.
Heard learned counsel for the parties, considering their rival submissions.

7. Looking to the facts and circumstances of the case and looking to the nature of allegations against the present applicant, he is in jail since 22/09/2022, trial is likely to take some time for disposal,

1 prosecutrix has turned hostile before the Court below, without commenting anything on merits of the case, the application is allowed.

sentences.text:
It is directed that in the event of applicant executing a personal bond for a sum of Rs. 25,000/- with one surety to the satisfaction of the concerned Trial Court, he shall be released on bail on the following conditions:-
(i) he shall not directly or indirectly make any inducement, threat or promise to any person acquainted with the facts of the case so as to dissuade his from disclosing such fact to the Court (ii) he shall not act in any manner which will be prejudicial to fair and expeditious trial, and (iii) he shall appear before the trial Court on each and every date given to his by the said Court till disposal of the trial.
he shall not involve himself in any offence of similar nature in future.
(v) he is restrained from meeting any of the prosecution witnesses till the conclusion of the trial.
8. It is made clear that these observations are only for the purposes of deciding the bail application.
The trial Court will decide the case on its own merits without being influenced by any observation made herein- above.
It is also made clear that the State is at liberty to move an application regarding cancellation of bail of the applicant in the event of applicant violates any of the conditions.
